visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair held by two silver clips faces the camera, wearing a black and white checkered shirt. She holds a black smartphone to her face and smiles, with purple and white text appearing on the screen. The background consists of white shelves with decorative items and plants in a bright, indoor setting. (2) The woman puts on a black face mask and presses it against her cheeks with both hands to demonstrate a transfer test. She then removes the mask and shows it to the camera, followed by a close-up of a white tissue being pressed against her face as a water spray is applied. (3) She holds up two makeup products: a rectangular foundation bottle with a purple cap and a cylindrical setting spray bottle, both from Maybelline. She gestures toward them with her fingers while colorful, stylized text overlays float around her. (4) A close-up shows her applying the light-colored foundation to her cheek using a pink makeup sponge, blending it into her skin. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the dewy finish of her makeup. (5) She shakes the purple setting spray bottle and sprays a fine mist over her face with her eyes closed, demonstrating the application process. High-contrast captions emphasize the 'feather-light' and 'moisturizing' qualities of the product. (6) She performs final tests by pressing her phone screen against her cheek and wearing the mask again, showing that no makeup has transferred to either surface. She ends the video by holding both products together near her face and waving at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female speech starts immediately with high arousal and a bright tone. An upbeat, electronic pop BGM provides a rhythmic foundation with a clear, synthetic beat. Occasional digital 'pop' sound effects accentuate the on-screen text appearances during the initial demonstration. (2) The narration shifts into a professional, explanatory mode while maintaining high clarity. The BGM remains consistent in the background. A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the change as she introduces the Maybelline products. The acoustic space feels very clean, resembling a studio environment. (3) Rapid, repeated misting sounds (shh-shh-shh) are heard as the setting spray is applied. The narrator's voice becomes more intimate and breathy for a moment to emphasize the 'feather-like' feeling. The music continues with a steady electronic pulse. (4) The audio track becomes hyper-dense with positive adjectives and quick vocal delivery as the speaker summarizes the test results. A final 'ding' sound effect plays at the conclusion, signaling the success of the makeup transfer test. The overall mix is well-balanced with high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Demonstration -> Product Reveal -> Application -> Evidence -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional advertisement for Maybelline's foundation and setting spray. It uses a problem-solution structure, showing the 'un-smudgeable' performance of the makeup through several tests (mask, phone, water) to prove its efficacy and encourage viewers to purchase the product bundle.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly names the brand Maybelline, shows the products clearly, and demonstrates their specific benefits using branded tags.
